modes.why: When the agent is developing: run phpcs, PHPStan, and JS lint on changed first-party files before finishing, then fix from red output.
After every first-party file write in the same turn, run the matching gates on that file before the next edit.
Do not run gates unless the user asks to lint, phpcs, phpstan, or verify.

recommended.why: Stop edits to Core and third-party plugins when git does not map them as first-party.
Catalog-first docs so the agent does not load the whole docs tree.
